reason: I think most supplements are a waste unless my doctor tells me to take one, and nobody has. The lab report is nice, but it only proves what is in the capsule, not that I need it.
objection: Nothing here says magnesium will do anything for me. A tested capsule is still a capsule I have no reason to swallow every day.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor recommending magnesium, or a blood test showing I am low.
